features.definition: 1 if the Pokémon is clearly bird-like (has beak, feathers, wings as primary feature), 0 otherwise
1 if the Pokémon is clearly fish, dolphin, whale, seahorse, or ocean-creature based, 0 otherwise
1 if the Pokémon resembles an insect, arachnid, or arthropod (has exoskeleton, multiple legs/claws, antennae typical of bugs), 0 otherwise
1 if the Pokémon is based on a reptile, turtle, or dinosaur, 0 otherwise
1 if the Pokémon resembles a four-legged furry mammal (dog, cat, bear, etc.), 0 otherwise
1 if the Pokémon stands upright on two legs with arm-like appendages in a roughly humanoid form, 0 otherwise
1 if the Pokémon has no clear defined body structure (blob, gas, cloud-like), 0 otherwise
1 if the Pokémon has a visible hard shell (turtle shell, snail shell, crustacean shell), 0 otherwise
1 if the Pokémon has visible wings (feathered, membranous, or insect wings), 0 otherwise
1 if green is the dominant or one of the two main body colors, 0 otherwise
1 if blue is the dominant or one of the two main body colors, 0 otherwise
1 if brown or tan is the dominant color, 0 otherwise
1 if the Pokémon is primarily dark-colored (black, dark gray, dark purple/navy), 0 otherwise
1 if the Pokémon is primarily light-colored (white, light gray, pale cream), 0 otherwise
Scale from 0 to 1 estimating perceived body bulk/size: 0 = very small and compact, 1 = very large and massive
Scale from 0 (looks cute, friendly, calm) to 1 (looks fierce, threatening, aggressive based on posture, expression, spikes)
1 if the Pokémon has prominent claws, horns, or sharp protrusions as notable features, 0 otherwise
1 if the Pokémon has a clearly visible tail, 0 otherwise
1 if the Pokémon has visible antennae or antenna-like protrusions on the head, 0 otherwise
1 if the Pokémon appears to be made of or heavily incorporates rock, stone, metal, or mineral materials, 0 otherwise
1 if the Pokémon incorporates plant features (leaves, flowers, vines, roots), 0 otherwise
1 if the Pokémon visibly has more than 4 limbs (e.g., 6+ legs like spiders/insects/octopus tentacles), 0 otherwise
1 if the Pokémon has tentacles, tendrils, or similar flexible appendages, 0 otherwise
1 if the Pokémon has glowing elements, sparkles, or luminescent features visible, 0 otherwise
1 if the Pokémon incorporates cloud, smoke, or gaseous elements as part of its body, 0 otherwise

Scale from 0 to 1: how small and cute/friendly the Pokémon appears. 1 = very small body with round friendly features (like a small rodent, puppy, or baby Pokémon), 0 = large intimidating or clearly adult/powerful Pokémon
1 if orange, reddish-brown, or warm earthy tones dominate the Pokémon's color scheme (not blue, not green, not pure white/black), 0 otherwise
1 if the Pokémon has a strongly aquatic or water-associated appearance (fins, gills, water-creature body shape, or is clearly a sea/ocean creature), 0 otherwise
1 if the Pokémon appears to be Ice-type based on its appearance: made of ice crystals, snow, glacial features, or has a clearly icy/frozen body composition. 0 otherwise.
1 if the Pokémon is primarily a flying creature (bird, bat, or other airborne creature) where flight is its primary identity, not just having wings. 0 otherwise.
1 if the Pokémon appears to be Rock or Ground type: made of rock, stone, earth, or geological materials as its primary body composition. 0 otherwise.
1 if the Pokémon incorporates significant plant/grass features (leaves, flowers, vines, seeds, grass) as a primary part of its body or identity, suggesting Grass type. 0 otherwise.

1 if the Pokémon has a mysterious, ethereal, or supernatural appearance suggesting Psychic or Ghost type: floating without visible means, glowing eyes, translucent body, eerie expression, or dream-like features. 0 otherwise.

1 if the Pokémon appears to be Fighting-type based on its appearance: muscular humanoid or animal body, combat-ready stance, martial arts posture, or physical fighting features like boxing gloves, fighting stance, strong arms. 0 otherwise.

1 if the Pokémon resembles a Normal-type: appears to be a common animal (mammal, bird, etc.) without obvious elemental features (no fire, water, ice, electric, etc. visual cues), looks like an everyday creature. 0 otherwise.

1 if the Pokémon appears to be Poison-type based on its appearance: has visible toxic features like purple/pink coloration with sludge, needles, fangs, or venomous appearance, or is clearly based on a poisonous creature. 0 otherwise.
